posts.headline: The African Bald Fraud case was closed last edition, but let's be real — mjwithgoldhoops is 8-2 with a league-best 1402.42 points, a middling 4-average-finish pedigree be damned, this is the best team in Busters Anonymous right now.
posts.detail: Two seasons in and a career 4th-place average finish never predicted this — Championshipsovercoochie is outscoring the entire league and the old slander has nothing left to grab onto.

posts.headline: Seven straight editions of burying Thicks and nothing's changed — 7-3 with a league-worst 1092.54 points-for among winning teams is still a champion coasting on a ring and nothing else.
posts.detail: A 1-title, 5.5-average-finish résumé earns the benefit of the doubt for exactly zero more weeks — Klint's Clipboard needs points, not vibes, before the playoffs expose this house of cards.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is 3-7 and a 20-8, back-to-back-finalist, 1.5-average-finish dynasty is now unrecognizable wreckage sitting in last place in the Titty Committee.
posts.detail: That career win percentage of .714 is the best in the league on paper, and yet here we are — 1070.78 points for a team that used to live in championship weekends.

posts.headline: Big Head's title defense isn't just dead anymore, it's a ghost story — 4-6 and a former champion's pedigree reduced to background noise in the Titty Committee basement.
posts.detail: A 1-title résumé with a 5.5 average finish was supposed to mean something, but Sasinci's 1097.22 points-for says Megamind has nothing left to defend.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still 0-10, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has run out of plagues to reference because the whole season is one long Exodus chapter.
posts.detail: A career .464 win pct and 5.5 average finish says this team should at least be mediocre, yet 1099.4 points-for and zero wins means the Belt has officially been chosen for the entire year.
